osm_report.threat_description:
Infostealer targeting Minecraft accounts, exfiltrating to a Discord webhook (Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:31). Payload in Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py.
Outbound: exfil. It reads credentials (Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:543) and sends data out (Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:31, Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:29).
Found by GitHub code search for a confirmed malware signature: "launcher_accounts.json" "api/webhooks".
Confirmed by static analysis; the code was read, never executed.
osm_report.payload_description:
Malicious payload found in: Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py
- Outbound: exfil. It reads credentials (Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:543) and sends data out (Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:31, Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:29).
- Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:543: reads Minecraft launcher account stores (Microsoft refresh and access tokens)
- Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:31: hardcoded Discord webhook, the drop point for stolen data (+1 more)
- Tiktok Share Bot/Tiktok Like Bot.py:775: runs shell commands through os.system (+1 more)
